recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future refinements to date prefix examples or search parameter descriptions should be handled under their own Jira issues, not by reopening FHIR-39373.
issue_request: FHIR-39373 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by FHIR-I. It asked the FHIR-core Search page's "Searching Multiple Values (joining with AND or OR)" section to define repeated search parameter behavior, including AND behavior for repeated parameters, scalar/array and simple/complex matching cases, repeated complex elements such as Patient.given, and date/range guidance so ge/le combinations are not misread as starts-after/ends-before constraints.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit 6941dfafeb121ffee973cdaae30102b8fd8566f0, which changed source/search.html under the FHIR-39373 subject. That commit added Search Test Basics, Matching and Cardinality, Matching and Sub-Elements, a repeated Patient given-name example in the multi-value section, an illustrative scalar/array/simple/complex join table, and additional date/range clarification. No Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-39373 existed on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: FHIR-40327 later requested the same-section repeated same-parameter example more explicitly; it is already represented on the combined branch by f8ece04dfecfedbecdc47120608f98eba282c2a3, which aligned the illustrative Patient values without changing the FHIR-39373 semantics. FHIR-40319 is also already represented on the combined branch and tightened adjacent prefix wording. The FHIR-I Henderson minutes record the FHIR-39373 6-0-2 Persuasive with Modification motion, and a Zulip "Date search on periods" thread mentions FHIR-39373 while discussing the same date-period ambiguity and planned Search page updates.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/search.html already includes the repeated-parameter AND example, element/cardinality guidance, the illustrative join table, prefix/date range text, a range-vs-boundary warning, and the Procedure date ge/le example.
